title: Beam Webinar – Beam Global and ScoutDI: Why This Acquisition Makes Sense
summary: Please join Beam Global CEO Desmond Wheatley for a live business update webinar this Thursday, October 15th, focused on Beam's recently announced planned acquisition of ScoutDI.
body_markdown:
Please join Beam Global CEO Desmond Wheatley for a live business update webinar this Thursday, October 15th, focused on Beam’s recently announced planned acquisition of ScoutDI.


During the presentation, Desmond will discuss the strategic vision for building a vertically integrated drone technology platform by combining Beam’s battery technology, power electronics and charging infrastructure with ScoutDI’s drone systems, specialized inspection payloads and software. He will also outline ScoutDI’s capabilities in GPS-denied environments, the opportunity to bring manufacturing to Beam’s U.S. facilities, and how the combined platform could expand Beam’s reach across industrial and defense markets.


Event Details:
Date: Thursday, October 15th
Time: 1.30PM PT / 4.30PM ET
Location: Zoom Webinar


Q&A Submission: Following the presentation, we will host a live Q&A session. To ensure we address the topics most important to our stakeholders, we strongly encourage you to submit your questions ahead of the call. Please send your questions toIR@BeamForAll.com by Wednesday, October 14, at 6:00 PM ET.


[Register here!](https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_AIh38h2vQYCcY3lmWh9JDA#/registration)


We look forward to your participation.
